verdict.rationale: Poly documents agent-driven bulk work. The agent can go through every invoice in a folder, extract fields and produce a CSV in one request, and it can automate organizing a folder, with subagents available for parallel tasks. Folder-level bulk actions round this out: one-click rollback of whole folders, cascading pin, whole-folder import, and a scriptable `poly` CLI. Missing for 10: an explicit documented batch-operation feature (e.g., multi-select bulk move/tag/delete), documented scale limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
